is_anopheles.evidence: The paper discusses Anopheles gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis in the context of gene drive technology and introgression (p. 3-4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr resistance in passing when reviewing literature on introgression (p. 4), but does not perform any genotyping.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts, allele counts, or frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito populations were collected or genotyped in this study.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a theoretical review and modelling paper deriving a formula (DRAQUE) to evaluate gene drive contamination risks.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; this is a theoretical review paper.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed because the paper contains no primary empirical field genotyping data.

assessment.summary: This paper presents a theoretical framework and formula (DRAQUE) to assess the risk of CRISPR-based gene drives transferring to non-target species. It is a review and opinion piece, containing no primary empirical genotype or bioassay data on field-caught Anopheles mosquitoes.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers
Does not report extractable genotype data
Does not study African field populations
Is not a primary empirical study (theoretical/review article)
